body:
I was at a keg party in the deep woods where a friend owned some land. someone had the great idea of shooting off fireworks,(bottle rockets) one caught in a pine tree about 20 ft from the ground amd caught on fire. I decided to climb up to try to shake it loose. the branch I was standing at about 10 ft, broke and I fell back 10 ft to the ground. A friend (a registered nurse) rushed over. She said I did not breath or have a pulse for more than 2 mins. I experienced a feeling of joining with everything around me and all knowledge of everything.
I experienced a feeling of joining with everything around me and all knowledge of everything.
I became a part of everything living and all that had lived but still with a conscience. My friend said I started breathing and I slowly got up with 3 broken ribs. Still to this day I know things about stuff and can't explain why.
